entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need some help with a return. I bought a cycling jersey a while back, and I'd like to send it back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. It's simply the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a ride yesterday and it's just way too tight for me to be comfortable.
I understand. Getting the right fit is crucial. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Mesh Pro jersey, delivered on November 25th of last year. That was about 52 days ago.
That sounds right. Is that going to be a problem?

Let me just confirm our policy for standard apparel. One moment... Okay, yes. According to my knowledge base, you have 90 days from the date of delivery for a return. So you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, perfect. That's great news. So, what's the process to exchange it for the next size up?
I can initiate that for you right now. I will email you a pre-paid return label. Just package the jersey and drop it off, and once we receive it, we'll ship out the larger size.

That works. Now, since I'm going through the process of an exchange and have to wait for the new item, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for the inconvenience? I was hoping to use it for a race next month.

I understand your position, but our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on sizing-related exchanges. The best I can do is ensure the return label is sent to you immediately so we can expedite the process on our end as soon as we get the original item back.
I see. Okay, no discount code. Fair enough. The pre-paid label is helpful, so I'll accept that. Please go ahead and send it over.
Of course. I've just processed the exchange and sent the return label to the email on file. You should receive it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
